findings.title: Published rehearsal prose retains the superseded stated-length condition
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Low interoperability/documentation inconsistency; no cipher change or rekey-confirmation bypass. A detected short-source verifier establishes consistency, not wallet identity. The reproduced 12-word short-source verifier is 128 bits; the separate 24-word walletCheck is 16 bits.
evidence: mhfe_spec v0.6.0 tag d954dc9f8df8c8d1fda075fb2be348d1f4877d41 and current specification have the same normative text.
findings.reproduction: For the public zero-12 container and correct test password, fullCheck({ words: 15 }) deliberately returns matches: true, path: null, evidence: { builtInCheck: 12, walletCheck: null }. The actual real-browser assertion at scripts/verify-browsers.mjs:1441-1447 passed in Chromium and Firefox, both standard and fast modes, in the exact tag CI log. The words field specifies the built-in reference count; the result has no sourceLength field.
findings.expected: The companion specification's rehearsal paragraph agrees with its recovery precedence rule for an owner-stated short length contradicted by another detected verifier.
findings.observed: Published specification v0.6.0 and the current companion specification README retain the stated-length condition for Matches in rehearsal, while the revised recovery rule and MHFE implementation accept another matching short layout and report its detected length. MHFE's own current README documents the intended precedence. Rekey separately refuses LENGTH_DIFFERS or ambiguity before sealing and requires eligible owner or external wallet confirmation.
findings.impact: A caller implementing the obsolete rehearsal sentence can disagree on check status for stated 15/detected 12 words. No unsafe rekey, wrong wallet identity or change to encrypted format was demonstrated.
findings.recommendedFix: Reconcile the companion specification rehearsal sentence with its detected-verifier precedence; retain detected-length evidence and the separate rekey confirmation requirement.
findings.requiredVerification: Compare no stated length and stated short lengths with zero, one and multiple verifier matches across recovery/rehearsal prose; retain the actual stated-15/detected-12 browser regression and wrong-password negative.
findings.relationToPriorFindings: Distinct from MHFE AUD-015-FUN001 automatic rekey confirmation, AUD-017-DOC002 omitted browser result fields, and mhfe_spec AUD-006-FUN002 overlapping 24-word reading rules. No prior finding ID is duplicated.

specificationQuotes.publishedTag: v0.6.0 at d954dc9f8df8c8d1fda075fb2be348d1f4877d41; normative text equals the current companion specification
specificationQuotes.recovery: a short length was stated, it does not match, and other lengths do: say so and continue as with no stated length;
specificationQuotes.rehearsal: It reports "matches" only when the reading of the stated length, or with no stated length the only matching length, passes its verifier, or when a supplied wallet-identity reference matches;
specificationQuotes.scope: The adjacent rehearsal MUST NOT clause prohibits displaying/copying/exporting/persisting recovered mnemonic material. The disputed condition is result prose, not an alleged violation of that privacy clause.

commands.label: browser-resume-integrity
argv:
import hashlib,json,stat,subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
host=root.parent/"multi-chain-wallet-tools"
evidence=root/"docs/audits/AUD-019-evidence"
output=evidence/"resume-browser-integrity.json"
if output.exists():raise SystemExit("Preserving existing resume-browser-integrity.json")
inventory_path=evidence/"browser-inventory.json"
inventory=json.loads(inventory_path.read_text())
records=[]
for original in inventory["files"]:
    if original["repository"]!="multi-chain-wallet-tools":continue
    path=host/original["path"]
    item={"path":original["path"],"expectedSha256":original["sha256"]}
    try:
        mode=path.lstat().st_mode
        if not stat.S_ISREG(mode):
            item.update(status="typeChanged",symlink=stat.S_ISLNK(mode),matches=False)
        else:
            actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            item.update(status="present",actualSha256=actual,matches=actual==original["sha256"])
    except FileNotFoundError:
        item.update(status="missing",matches=False)
    records.append(item)
candidate=root/"canonical-output-signing-v0.6.0"
presence=[]
for name in ["SHA256SUMS.asc","RELEASE-SIGNING-KEY.asc"]:
    path=candidate/name
    try:
        info=path.lstat()
        presence.append({"path":str(path.relative_to(root)),"present":True,
                         "regularFile":stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode),"symlink":stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode),
                         "bytes":info.st_size,"contentsRead":False})
    except FileNotFoundError:
        presence.append({"path":str(path.relative_to(root)),"present":False,"contentsRead":False})
changed=[item for item in records if not item["matches"]]
manifest_path=host/"packages/recovery-mhfe-wasm/generated/modules.json"
manifest_record=next(item for item in records if item["path"]=="packages/recovery-mhfe-wasm/generated/modules.json")
identity=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text()) if manifest_record["matches"] else None
host_head=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(host),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
dirty=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(host),"status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=no"],text=True)
value={"auditId":"AUD-019","capturedUtc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
       "reviewer":{"task":"browser resume integrity","model":None,"actualReasoningEffort":None},
       "method":"Read/hash inventoried public host source and generated package files; lstat candidate signature/public-key presence only. No target execution or signature verification.",
       "inventoryPath":str(inventory_path.relative_to(root)),
       "inventorySha256":hashlib.sha256(inventory_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
       "originalInventoryUtc":inventory["capturedUtc"],"hostHead":host_head,
       "hostTrackedWorkingTree":"dirty" if dirty else "clean",
       "hostVersion":identity.get("version") if identity else None,
       "hostBuildId":identity.get("buildId") if identity else None,
       "comparedFiles":len(records),"mismatches":changed,"comparisons":records,
       "candidateSignaturePublicKeyPresence":presence,
       "adjudication":"All inventoried host source/package bytes remain unchanged." if not changed else "Host byte changes require reconciliation before reusing original integration conclusions.",
       "limits":["Presence does not establish signature authenticity or current private draft inventory.",
                 "Foreign host remains outside clean MHFE commit closure; no complete host UI acceptance or signed-release admission is established.",
                 "No builds, browsers, KDFs, vectors, paid workflows or product/harness edits were performed.",
                 "Non-regular files are recorded without reading their targets. No secret/signature/public-key contents were read."]}
output.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"path":str(output.relative_to(root)),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "comparedFiles":len(records),"mismatchCount":len(changed),"hostBuildId":value["hostBuildId"],
                  "signingFiles":presence}))
raise SystemExit(0 if not changed else 1)

Linux/native/package tests ran locally. macOS ARM and Windows acceptance are exact-tag CI observations; Linux ARM and macOS x86-64 archives were cross-compiled, not executed locally. macOS canonical reproduction was not performed.

Local Unicode generator verification refused the installed Unicode 16 module; exact-tag CI used pinned unicodedata2 17.0.1/Unicode 17.0.0 and passed the full width-table check. No local data downgrade was made.

The current private draft Release API returned inaccessible/404 in this environment. Successful creation logs and matching retained candidate bytes do not prove its current private inventory. No absent draft or invalid authentication token is inferred.

The retained candidate has no SHA256SUMS.asc or RELEASE-SIGNING-KEY.asc. Owner signing, verification against the intended OpenPGP key, upload and final download verification are pending publication steps; no release was published by this audit.

The foreign host has current matching package/source handover at inventoried dirty bytes; its signed published-package admission and complete host UI/viewport regressions were not verified. AUD-018-BLD001 is fixed in this current working-tree trigger scope, with no signed host closure claimed.

Historical unavailable specification commits are explicitly disclosed, not reconstructed. AUD-015-BLD001 old v0.3.0-v0.5.0 release asset/provenance verification remains open; current v0.6.0 attestations do not certify old assets.

Secret wiping and isolation were checked through source ownership and bounded observable refusals/readbacks. Physical allocator remnants, browser GC, encrypted swap, firmware, laptop access, malware outside the repository and key/account custody were not independently certified.

Verifier bootstrap used official GitHub HTTPS and matching official checksum, without an independently authenticated signature on the verifier download. Attestation verification therefore trusts that bootstrap and the verifier's Sigstore/GitHub roots.
